title: Deathly Rock
text:
Walkthrough

After getting to the top cliff from the previous chapter, keep walking until you get near to a large wooden log. Put at most a few steps to the log, then run back to the left side before the boulder gets you. After that, wait until the boulder stops moving, then jump over it, then move forward a bit.

Just a few meters, the path shows trees with a hanging vine, then a large lake next to it. The crate won't help crossing the lake, because the boy cannot swim. However, you can use this crate by pulling it back to the hanging vine. Next, go above the crate, climb the vine, and swing back and forth a few times until you can jump onto the branch on the right side. Keep jumping on the large branches until you reach the top branch of the right-most tree. That tree features dead wood on the top, which can be knocked down. Climb back down, and then push and use the floating wood to cross the lake. Given that the wood doesn't fully cover the lake, you'll have to jump to the other side on the gap between the floating wood and the ground on the other side.
